description: Comment on a wiki page, or reply to one of its comments ('replyTo' is a comment id from get_wiki_page). A reply notifies the author of the comment it answers, whether or not they watch the page — no mention needed — and they are told once even if also mentioned. Identify the page by 'pageId', or by 'spaceKey' + 'title'. Markdown is rendered; mention someone as [@Their Name](user:username), the wiki's own form. Requires permission to comment in that project. Answers with 'notified' (who this actually reaches, the answered author included), 'answered' (for a reply: whose comment it answers, and 'notified' false with a 'reason' when they are not told) and 'unresolvedMentions' (what looked like a mention and reached nobody, each with a reason) — a wrong handle is stored as written and never refused, so that list is the only sign it did not land.

body.description: Comment body as Markdown, which also carries $…$ / $$…$$ LaTeX formulas.

cell.description: With 'table': the cell's address as a formula writes it, e.g. 'B3' (a merged cell at the place it starts).

replyTo.description: The comment this one answers, as returned by get_wiki_page.

row.description: With 'table': the row's number, from 1 (a header row counts).

spaceKey.description: Space key, when identifying the page by title.

table.description: To comment on a table's cell, row or column (PM-1540): the table's place among the page's tables, from 0 — get_wiki_page's 'tables[].table' — with exactly one of 'cell', 'row' or 'column'. Not on a reply.

title.description: Exact page title, when identifying the page by title.

name: add_wiki_comment
title: Add wiki comment
